entries.title: Exodus 40:1
segments: ¶Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

entries.title: Exodus 40:2
segments: "On the first day of the first month you shall set up the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.

entries.title: Exodus 40:3
segments: "You shall put in it the ark of the Testimony, and partition off the ark with the veil.

entries.title: Exodus 40:4
segments: "You shall bring in the table and arrange the things that are to be set in order on it; and you shall bring in the lampstand and light its lamps.

entries.title: Exodus 40:5
segments: "You shall also set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the Testimony, and put up the screen for the door of the tabernacle.

entries.title: Exodus 40:6
segments: "Then you shall set the altar of the burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.

entries.title: Exodus 40:7
segments: "And you shall set the laver between the tabernacle of meeting and the altar, and put water in it.

entries.title: Exodus 40:8
segments: "You shall set up the court all around, and hang up the screen at the court gate.

entries.title: Exodus 40:9
segments: "And you shall take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle and all that [is] in it; and you shall hallow it and all its utensils, and it shall be holy.

entries.title: Exodus 40:10
segments: "You shall anoint the altar of the burnt offering and all its utensils, and consecrate the altar. The altar shall be most holy.

entries.title: Exodus 40:11
segments: "And you shall anoint the laver and its base, and consecrate it.

entries.title: Exodus 40:12
segments: "Then you shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the tabernacle of meeting and wash them with water.

entries.title: Exodus 40:13
segments: "You shall put the holy garments on Aaron, and anoint him and consecrate him, that he may minister to Me as priest.

entries.title: Exodus 40:14
segments: "And you shall bring his sons and clothe them with tunics.

entries.title: Exodus 40:15
segments: "You shall anoint them, as you anointed their father, that they may minister to Me as priests; for their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations."

entries.title: Exodus 40:16
segments: ¶Thus Moses did; according to all that the LORD had commanded him, so he did.

entries.title: Exodus 40:17
segments: And it came to pass in the first month of the second year, on the first [day] of the month, [that] the tabernacle was raised up.

entries.title: Exodus 40:18
segments: So Moses raised up the tabernacle, fastened its sockets, set up its boards, put in its bars, and raised up its pillars.

entries.title: Exodus 40:19
segments: And he spread out the tent over the tabernacle and put the covering of the tent on top of it, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 40:20
segments: He took the Testimony and put [it] into the ark, inserted the poles through the rings of the ark, and put the mercy seat on top of the ark.

entries.title: Exodus 40:21
segments: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, hung up the veil of the covering, and partitioned off the ark of the Testimony, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 40:22
segments: He put the table in the tabernacle of meeting, on the north side of the tabernacle, outside the veil;

entries.title: Exodus 40:23
segments: and he set the bread in order upon it before the LORD, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 40:24
segments: He put the lampstand in the tabernacle of meeting, across from the table, on the south side of the tabernacle;

entries.title: Exodus 40:25
segments: and he lit the lamps before the LORD, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 40:26
segments: He put the gold altar in the tabernacle of meeting in front of the veil;

entries.title: Exodus 40:27
segments: and he burned sweet incense on it, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 40:28
segments: He hung up the screen [at] the door of the tabernacle.

entries.title: Exodus 40:29
segments: And he put the altar of burnt offering [before] the door of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting, and offered upon it the burnt offering and the grain offering, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 40:30
segments: He set the laver between the tabernacle of meeting and the altar, and put water there for washing;

entries.title: Exodus 40:31
segments: and Moses, Aaron, and his sons would wash their hands and their feet [with water] from it.

entries.title: Exodus 40:32
segments: Whenever they went into the tabernacle of meeting, and when they came near the altar, they washed, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 40:33
segments: And he raised up the court all around the tabernacle and the altar, and hung up the screen of the court gate. So Moses finished the work.

entries.title: Exodus 40:34
segments: ¶Then the cloud covered the tabernacle of meeting, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

entries.title: Exodus 40:35
segments: And Moses was not able to enter the tabernacle of meeting, because the cloud rested above it, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

entries.title: Exodus 40:36
segments: Whenever the cloud was taken up from above the tabernacle, the children of Israel would go onward in all their journeys.

entries.title: Exodus 40:37
segments: But if the cloud was not taken up, then they did not journey till the day that it was taken up.

entries.title: Exodus 40:38
segments: For the cloud of the LORD [was] above the tabernacle by day, and fire was over it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.
